# Exclusion fixture — an over-long line inside the header block

**Status:** draft
**Note:** 
absorbed
**Kind:** doc.

## 1. Body

The over-long line above is itself a field marker, so headerField over the
RAW lines terminates on it and yields `draft`. scanDoc drops it before the
buffer sees it (ANTS-2139 INV-3), so `absorbed` closes up against the Status
field and the buffered value becomes `draft absorbed` — prose absorbed into
a value it was never adjacent to. INV-2's fourth-condition bound, asserted.
